change: Bind image deduplication and resource accounting to actual live text documents rather than raw row/part/url for the whole chat. Revalidate rebuilt recipients through unchanged host image signal.
regressionCases: two documents sharing one raw part URL
delete and replace owner on request
delete and replace owner on image publication
positive raster and text pixels in light/dark620/350
limits: 32 live document/URL bindings and64MiB accepted downscaled raster accounting per view. URL churn in the same retained document consumes bindings until that document is destroyed.
Fresh recipient is revalidated by the host; no automatic HTTP/file loading or cross-row trusted-byte cache introduced.
Early TranscriptText QPointer guard is covered by publication deletion/replacement tests; no separate pre-fix crash probe was run.
